_README: Durable notes surfaced in the Fix queue tab of reports/site-report.html.
The report is regenerated in full every run, so notes MUST live here — anything typed into the HTML is lost on the next run.
Keys are scraper names exactly as they appear in scrapers/scraper-registry.js, plus two special keys.
Each scraper value: { note: string, priority: 'high'|'normal'|'low', added: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }.
_global: one note shown above the Fix queue and applied to every fix.

_pending: OBJECT keyed by scraper name -> { what, expect, confirm, added }. A change already made whose effect has not been observed yet. Shown as an AWAITING badge on that scraper's Coverage row and in its Fix queue detail. Delete the key once confirmed.
A note on a scraper with no detected issues still shows up in the Fix queue, so this doubles as a to-do list.

_global.note: STOP before doing WordPress-{state} selector work. Measured 2026-08-05 with scripts/find-duplicate-library-urls.js: 355 domains are shared across two or more ACTIVE states, covering 1073 of the ~4069 configured library entries. The seed data was generated by guessing '{city}library.org' from the city name, so madisonlibrary.org is assigned to libraries in 11 states, greenvillelibrary.org in 10, franklinlibrary.org in 10. A domain can be the real site of at most one of them. Until the URLs are corrected, a scraper returning 0 events may simply be pointed at another state's library — and broadening extraction would ingest that other library's events under the wrong name and state. Fix URLs before selectors. General discipline: read SCRAPER-FIX-LOG.jsonl first, verify claims before acting, run `node -c` on every modified scraper, and append one line per logical fix to SCRAPER-FIX-LOG.jsonl. SECOND SEED-DATA DEFECT, measured 2026-08-05: the same generator also fabricated county names by appending ' County' to the city ('Arcadia County', 'Brandon County', 'Archer County' -- none are real counties). Across the 20 active WordPress-{state} library files, 2065 of 2137 county values (96.6%) fail getCountyCentroid() lookup; only 72 resolve. Worst: NY 416 bad, MA 231, PA 206, NJ 166; VT/TN/KY/MS/WV are 100% bad. Effect: the county-centroid tier of the geocoding chain is effectively dead for this entire family, so any library whose address/city geocode fails lands on the STATE centroid. This is the same class of work as the URL remediation and needs a real city-to-county data source -- do not guess counties one at a time.

WordPress-NC.note: 90% of entries (80 of 89) share a domain with another state — the worst in the family. Do NOT treat its 7 zero-event MISMATCHes as extraction bugs until each URL is verified. Pettigrew Regional Library and Tyrrell County Library were fixed 2026-08-05 (the first had pointed at a Michigan library). All 79 colliding entries were mapped to their real parent system via the State Library of NC directory; see reports/nc-url-audit.md. NOTE: an earlier recommendation in that file to delete 18 entries as 'already covered elsewhere' was REVERSED the same day — it used circular evidence and mistook scrape-time FOUND counts for database coverage. wordpress-NC is in fact the second-largest library event producer in NC with 275 rows. Establish 'covered elsewhere' only with scripts/verify-coverage.js, never by matching venue names. QUEUE UPDATE 2026-08-06: 30 of 89 entries are now verified. The remaining 59 are 50 still-colliding plus 9 that were never checked because their domain does not collide (bunnlibrary.org, dobsonlibrary.org, farmvillelibrary.libguides.com, hickorylibrary.org, indiantraillibrary.org, kinglibrary.org, louisburglibrary.org, roanokerapidslibrary.org, starlibrary.org). A non-colliding domain is still a guessed domain - verify those 9 the same way. See reports/nc-url-audit.md.

WordPress-VT.note: 72% of entries (69 of 96) have a colliding domain. Selector normalization was considered and deliberately deferred: VT and CT use a narrower 3-selector list than their 6 siblings, but broadening it while most URLs are unverified would ingest other states' events rather than fix coverage. Verify URLs first.

WordPress-CT.note: 68% of entries (79 of 116) have a colliding domain. Same deferral as VT — the narrower selector list is real and worth fixing, but only after the URLs are trustworthy.

WordPress-TN.note: 67% of entries (54 of 81) have a colliding domain, including the Seymour TN->CT and Baxter TN->ME cases found by Step 3d on 2026-08-04. Highest raw bug count in the family (15). Treat as a seed-data problem first, not an extraction problem.

WordPress-AL.note: COVERAGE GAP: Hightower Memorial Library (York, AL) was removed 2026-08-05. Its configured URL yorklibrary.org serves Kilgore Memorial Library in York, Nebraska, and the Alabama library has no official website — only a Facebook page, which this scraper cannot read. If it ever gets a site, re-add it. Do not re-add a guessed domain.

WordPress-GA.note: Part of the known WordPress-{state} platform-heterogeneity problem: each library runs a different theme/plugin, so there is no generic patch — this needs per-site DOM work. Confirm the URL is the right institution before blaming extraction.

WordPress-FL.note: RESOLVED 2026-08-05: the five major systems (Miami-Dade, Orange, Tampa-Hillsborough, Broward, Palm Beach) that had no city/state and county 'Baltimore City' now carry correct main-branch city/state/zip and real county keys, verified against utils/county-centroids.js. SEPARATE STILL-OPEN ISSUE: 61 of this file's other 66 county values (92%) are fabricated by the same seed generator (it appended ' County' to the city name, e.g. 'Arcadia County', 'Brandon County', 'Archer County'), so they resolve to nothing and those libraries still fall through to the FL state centroid. See the _global note for the family-wide measurement.

Communico-NJ.note: RESOLVED 2026-08-05: Montclair Public Library moved to LibCal-NJ with its real bccls.libcal.com/calendar/montclair URL; the dead libnet.info entry was removed. Verify on the next Group 2 run that Montclair returns a nonzero count under LibCal-NJ.

Communico-SC.note: PARTIALLY RESOLVED 2026-08-05: the two dead libnet.info entries (Greenville County, Richland) were removed - they 302-redirected to google.co.uk and could never return events. The COVERAGE GAP REMAINS OPEN and was not handed to a working replacement: CustomDrupal-Libraries already has both correct URLs (greenvillelibrary.org/events, richlandlibrary.com/events) and reported finding 10 and 30 events on 2026-08-05, yet the DB holds 0 upcoming rows for Greenville County and 1 for Richland. Both live sites verified to have real dated events, so this is a CustomDrupal-Libraries EXTRACTION bug, not a URL problem. That is the next thing to fix for SC.

WordPress-MD.note: MARYLAND PRIORITY PASS 2026-08-06. Good news first: this file is the healthiest in the family - 10 real entries, every county resolving via getCountyCentroid, no fabricated {city}library.org domains. A 2026-04-27 cleanup already removed ~130 fabricated branch URLs here, which is why. Two genuine coverage gaps were found and closed: Ruth Enlow Library of Garrett County (relib.net, verified live) had ZERO rows in the database, and Kent County Public Library (kentcountylibrary.org, verified live) had only festival-scraper rows. Both are now configured. The file had carried a comment claiming Garrett was covered by scraper-librarymarket-libraries-md.js - that file is NOT registered in scraper-registry.js and never runs, so the claim was false. dorchesterlibrary.org and worcesterlibrary.org both verified as MARYLAND's; the MA/WI/NY entries sharing them are the wrong ones.

LibCal-TN.note: Memphis Public Libraries fixed 2026-08-05: configured URL memphislibrary.libcal.com was dead (404), repointed to the real site memphis.librarycalendar.com, which this shared scraper file already knows how to parse (same format as Albany/Long Beach/Levittown entries). Re-run to confirm a nonzero count.

CustomDrupal-Libraries.note: EXTRACTION GAP found 2026-08-05: reported 356 found / 65 new on the 2026-08-05 run, but the DB holds 0 upcoming rows attributed to it, and 0 for Richland Library and Greenville County Library System specifically. Both live sites were fetched and DO show real dated events (Richland: Hello Baby Aug 6, Family Storytime Aug 7). Found-not-saved, or saved under venue/scraper names that do not match. This scraper is now the sole configured owner of both SC systems after the dead Communico duplicates were removed, so its extraction is the blocker for South Carolina library coverage.

WordPress-NY.note: Two collisions fixed 2026-08-05 and their bad data deleted: Greenville Public Library (was on greenvillelibrary.org = Greenville County SC) repointed to greenville.lib.ny.us, and Phillips Free Library (was on homerlibrary.org = Homer Glen IL) repointed to phillipsfreelibrary.org. Both verified live with ZIPs matching the config. 226 orphan rows removed. NOTE this file is the largest in the family at 422 entries and 416 of its county values are fabricated - see the _global note.

WordPress-SC.note: Found during the WordPress-NC Phase 2 pass 2026-08-05: 'Lexington County Library - Gaston' is configured with gastonlibrary.org, which is verified to be Gaston County Public Library in NORTH CAROLINA. The town of Gaston SC is served by Lexington County Library, and its county value 'Gaston County' is also wrong - Gaston SC is in Lexington County. Both need the real Lexington County Library URL researched and verified live. Not fixed during the NC pass to stay in scope.
